workflow_runs.display_title: launcher(#748 r25): ghi model do máy chủ trả cho từng response của lượt codex

head_commit.message:
launcher(#748 r25 vong 3): stderr codex chi ghi dong trong danh sach cho phep NGUYEN VAN

Cross-review l909d (head aaad9ab): 1 P1 + 4 P2. Chu kho chon phuong an "chi giu dong trong danh sach
cho phep" (24-10-2026, trong phien; spec r25 v2 se ghi lai).
- R25-SEC-01 / CONTRACT-07: stderr.log cua luot codex chi nhan dong TRON VEN bang nguyen van mot muc
  _STDERR_CHO_PHEP; moi byte khac bi bo va chi duoc DEM (stderr_bo_dong / stderr_bo_byte). Khong con
  doan dong nao nguy hiem: thu cham dia la hang so trong ma.
- R25-EVID-05: doan giong khung response.created/completed ma khong nhan duoc (vuot tran, cut o EOF,
  giua doan doc, UTF-8 hong, id/model rong) tinh vao dem["mat"] => KHONG_DO_DUOC kem ly do.
- R25-RACE-06: _ghi_ket_qua_model chot trang thai luong doc TRUOC, roi chup danh sach/loi/dem; trang
  thai va cac truong so suy tu cung anh chup.
- R25-TEST-03: ca + dot bien rieng cho cong ca-dong khi parse, xa ong co gioi han, loi that cua luong
  doc di toi so, mat khung di toi so, chot luong truoc khi chup.

launcher_test 272/272 (2 bo qua san co, rieng Windows), nhat ky vao=ra=274 + XONG TRON VEN.
25/25 dot bien r25_* GIET boi TinHieuChotCa cua dung ca dich. Ruff F delta 0 (5 = 5).
Luot codex that qua launcher (RUST_LOG thua ke reqwest/hyper trace): DO_DUOC, gpt-6.1-sol x2,
stderr.log 39 byte (dung dong cho phep), bo 305 dong / 544638 byte; pkg_secret_scan rc=0.
CHU Y: +498 dong them so master, VUOT tran sensitive ADR-0053 (450) - cho chu kho quyet nang_tran
truoc khi review vong 3.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_014eUnFtkty9fZicFG9T1Wei
